replacement: “So you do not believe it?” he said. “You preach it and do not believe it yourself. Believe me, this dream, as you call it, will certainly come true. It will come, but not yet, for every process has its law. This is a spiritual, a psychological process. If the world is to be changed and made new, men must first turn to another path in their minds. Until you have truly, in actual fact, become a brother to everyone, brotherhood will not come. No scientific teaching, no common interest, will ever teach men to share property and privilege with the same fairness to all. Everyone will think his share too small. They will always be envying one another, complaining and attacking. You ask when it will come. It will come, but first we must pass through a time of isolation.”

For a long time I could not believe him. I did not believe him then, but only after he had come to me three days running and told me all of it. I thought he was mad, but I ended by being convinced, to my great grief and amazement. His crime was great and terrible.
